test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
If the following sheet is folded to form a cube, which of the given figure are possible ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c1ac09c09c2d713063c837aca432f6b027e5675ef8879039e51d994150b0828.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fe13286f0bebae1dfe7a49ae905acc2fa00252572dc516295e0dc6f6aa36acd.png]
solution: For the given open dice: All the four letters except P and R are out of the line. So, they are opposite of each other as shown below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c009df0e4b516c2afe2fd428b71457781372046f7eddf507f8812fd14c68ab0b.png] Next, we take all the letters which are in line. Here, Q is opposite of U and T is opposite of S.
